title: Places for Autistic Students in Special Schools
what_it_is: Places for Autistic Students in Special Schools

sections.label: SPED school places and waiting time
sections.summary: SPED schools have sufficient places, with waiting times from three months to over a year depending on capacity, demand and student factors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Overall, there are sufficient places in our SPED schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The waiting time for admission into these schools can range from three months to more than a year, depending on the school's capacity and the relative demand, as well as student factors, such as the complexity of the particular child's needs and the availability of the right mix of staff to support his or her needs.

sections.label: MOE expanding ASD school capacity
sections.summary: MOE works with VWOs to expand ASD-specific school capacity and with NCSS and SPED schools to recruit more teachers and allied professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: To cater to these needs, the Ministry of Education (MOE) is working with various volunteer welfare organisations (VWOs) to expand the overall capacity of the ASD-specific schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: We are also working closely with the National Council of Social Service (NCSS) and SPED schools to recruit more teachers and allied professionals.

sections.label: SPED capacity, manpower and special needs training
sections.summary: Total SPED capacity and facilities exist, but manpower and skills are needed for compulsory education, and special needs training lacks a basic degree course.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I do not have the exact numbers for the Member's last part of the question, Mdm Speaker.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would reassure him on the point he made that there is a place available within the SPED space.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In terms of total capacity, the spaces are there, the facilities are there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But it is really looking forward towards the timeline of the implementation of compulsory education for special needs children and ensuring that we have the skill ability and the manpower ability across the various schools to make sure that each child has an appropriate place and, hopefully, to reduce the anxiety that some parents may have about finding a particular place in a particular school, when there are several schools that can manage that child's needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Based on my understanding, there is a Master's degree course and an Advanced Degree course, but not a basic degree course in special needs education.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We do have some ability to do some training here in Singapore, but we also do tap on the skills and training available overseas or returning Singaporeans for people who want to come and work in special education.
